concerns.text: The plan lists `bitsandbytes==0.43.1` as a primary dependency for the 8‑bit quantized GPT‑2 model and states the inference will run on a CPU‑only GitHub Actions runner. `bitsandbytes` primarily provides GPU‑accelerated 8‑bit kernels and does not support efficient CPU‑only inference; attempting to load it on a CPU‑only environment will raise import errors or fall back to unquantized inference, violating the free‑tier compute constraints. Replace `bitsandbytes` with a CPU‑compatible quantization library (e.g., `auto-gptq` with `torch` CPU kernels) or use a smaller model that can run natively on CPU without bitsandbytes.
